name: hlplanet-mcp
description: Compare keyboard sizes and 30 real keyboards, check desk and mousepad fit, and search HLPlanet keyboard reviews.
long_description: Keyboard size answers backed by real data from HLPlanet.com. Compare full-size, 98%, TKL, 75%, 65% and 60% layouts (size difference, missing keys, extra mouse room), look up the measured dimensions of 30 reviewed keyboards, check whether a keyboard and mousepad fit on your desk including a full 360 turn at your sensitivity, find which sizes have a key like Delete or F5, and search HLPlanet reviews of Hall effect, TMR and rapid trigger keyboards. No account or API key needed.
